# Science & Plants for Schools (SAPS)

> SAPS provides plant science teaching resources, practicals, and professional development for UK educators across primary, secondary, and post-16 levels.

Based at Cambridge University Botanic Garden and supported by the Gatsby Charitable Foundation, SAPS offers curated practical resources aligned to GCSE and A-level specifications, alongside CPD opportunities through the Ambassador Scheme and Growth Hub.

## Key Topics

- Plant science education
- Teaching practicals
- A-level biology
- GCSE resources
- Microscopy teaching
- Secondary biology
- Plant biology
- Classroom practicals
- Teacher professional development
- SAPS Ambassadors
- Growth Hub
- Cambridge University Botanic Garden
- Gatsby Foundation
- Science clubs
- CPD resources

## Teaching Resources

- [Teaching Resources](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources): Main teaching resources hub for primary, secondary and post-16 biology
- [Resource Collections](https://www.saps.org.uk/resource-collections): Curated collections of plant biology practicals for GCSE and A-level
- [A-level Set Practicals](https://www.saps.org.uk/resource-collections/a-level-set-practicals): A-level biology practicals for OCR, AQA, Edexcel and Eduqas specifications
- [Science Clubs](https://www.saps.org.uk/resource-collections/science-clubs): Plant science resources for STEM and science clubs
- [Teaching Microscopy Using Plants](https://www.saps.org.uk/growth-hub/teaching-microscopy-using-plants): Guide to teaching microscopy with readily available plant specimens

## Professional Development & Growth Hub

- [Growth Hub](https://www.saps.org.uk/growth-hub): Long reads, scientist interviews, podcasts and CPD resources for teachers
- [SAPS Ambassadors](https://www.saps.org.uk/about-saps/saps-ambassadors): SAPS Ambassador Scheme connecting UK teachers for professional development
- [Get Help with Resources](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/get-help-with-resources): Support and helpline for SAPS resources via Expert Panel and Associates

## About SAPS

- [About SAPS](https://www.saps.org.uk/about-saps): About SAPS mission, partnerships with Cambridge and Gatsby Foundation
- [Meet the Team](https://www.saps.org.uk/about-saps/meet-the-team): SAPS team profiles including Dan Jenkins and Gatsby programme staff
- [Contact](https://www.saps.org.uk/about-saps/contact): Contact details for SAPS at Cambridge University Botanic Garden

## Community & Updates

- [Homepage](https://www.saps.org.uk): SAPS homepage introducing plant science education for teachers and students
- [Sign Up to Our Newsletter](https://www.saps.org.uk/about-saps/newsletter): Half-termly newsletter signup with plant science teaching ideas
